description: Create a throwaway URL that records the next HTTP request anyone sends to it, headers and body included. Use it to see what a webhook provider, a form or a third party service actually transmits, instead of trusting their documentation, and to prove that an integration fired at all. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly. The pending capture is stored before this call returns. Optional notify_url receives one small completion signal with a result URL after the first request arrives. The callback does not contain the captured request. Whatever is sent to update_url becomes publicly readable, so do not use it for secrets, credentials or personal data.

notify_url.description: Optional public HTTP or HTTPS callback. It receives one small signal after capture.
